body:
GREG, 2026-11-18, on task-sync Git cost. Verbatim:
- Asistant 43498a6e #1570: „ale nadal ilosc procesow git nie powina zalezyc wogole od ilosci taskow”.
- Asistant #1572: „+ Kimi, nie chce pieprzonego grupowania, cudowania. nadal nie rozumiem po co odapalmy git przy exporcie w ten spob. grupowanie NIC NAM NIE DAJE WTF”.
- Said directly to Kimi::Consultant, relayed at c15db92c #357: „KORWA, czemu nie pilnujesz tego co oni wyrabiaja”.
RULE:
- The number of git launches in task-sync export and import is constant, independent of total AND changed task counts. Data volume may grow with changes.
- Batching or chunking is NOT a fix. Remove the reason git is called: export takes changes from the DB feed, and the store records its own export commit and last applied commit. Import uses one diff, with changed files read from disk.
SUPERVISION:
- READY for such work is valid only with a deterministic count test (equal launches at K = 1/100/2,000 changed of N = 2,000, plus N = 200 vs 2,000) present and passing on the exact candidate, plus a list of every git call on the ordinary path.
- Kimi inspects the diff before the review pair.
- Coordinators check that a fix removes the growth before accepting a plan; don't accept rounds that only shave it.
Items: w-808add714773 (export) and w-45fe538db32a (import).
